title: docs(skills): stop teaching objectui as a separate repo, list it in the catalog index, repair dead anchors, author sharingModel in object examples
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8SGTdYN8vqh1R82GjyqZn5)_

Fixes #31114

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling). The maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03) waives it, and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectui` 技能 README、`page-builder.md` 和目录 README 不再把 ObjectUI 说成独立仓库，改指本仓库 `ui/` 与目录 README 的固定版本 `experimental_sync` 安装；`build-skill-docs.ts` 按“有 `SKILL.md` 且非 `metadata.internal`”收录技能，生成的索引与文档页补上 `objectui`；修三处死锚点；`bootstrap.md` 版本改为 `18.3.0`；`relationships.md`、`lifecycle.md`、`datasources.md` 的完整对象示例补 `sharingModel`；`indexing.md` 的租户列改为注入的 `organization_id`；`objectstack-query` 补 `$empty`；升级技能注明 `objectstack-pm-dispatch` 已不在 18 目录中。
- 为什么改：UI 合入本仓库和几次“原样搬移”重构后，这些地方仍在教过时或会被拒的写法（#31114）：缺 `sharingModel` 的对象发布会被 `security-owd-unset` 拒绝；索引写未声明的 `tenant_id` 会被字段引用检查拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字、eval、一个生成脚本及其生成产物；所有文件都在 token 上限内，未上调任何上限：七个文件（`objectui/README.md`、`relationships.md`、`indexing.md`、`plugin-lifecycle.md`、`service-registry.md`、`objectstack-query/SKILL.md`、`objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`）的增长落在既有余量内，其余靠同文件删除重复内容支付，见下文；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts` 的收录谓词，和 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 的 `sharingModel` 示例。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`，预期都退出 0。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H（人合），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的一次 approval，之后席位落地。

## What changes

Every item was re-read on `main` before editing (the card was measured on `aa3e21cc`; this branch is on `9f61e06e`).

### 1. ObjectUI is not a separate repository

Code site: the UI lives at `ui/` in this repository since #25752, and `packages/skills` ships the `objectui` skill since #25832.

- `skills/README.md` § Related repositories → § Related code: `ui/` in this repository (link to `tree/main/ui`), in place of the archived `objectstack-ai/objectui` link.
- `skills/objectui/README.md`: the `skills.sh` badge for `objectstack-ai/objectui` is removed. The install section now says the skill ships in `@objectstack/skills`, shows the two pinned commands the catalog README teaches (`pnpm add -D "@objectstack/skills@…"` + `npx skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`), and links the catalog README for other package managers and agents. That link is an absolute `objectstack/blob/main/skills/README.md` URL: `ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` (L732, `diskRoot: '../skills/objectui'`) refuses a relative href that leaves the bundle, because the skill ships to customer projects as one directory. The "CLI auto-detects your agent" sentence is removed, because it is false under `experimental_sync --agent`. The repository link now points at `ui/`.
- `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`: the `plugin-gantt` README link now goes to `objectstack/tree/main/ui/packages/plugin-gantt`, a directory page that renders the README. That URL is 3 bytes shorter, so it fits the ceiling.

### 2. The catalog index lists `objectui`

Code site: `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts`. The `startsWith('objectstack-')` filter is replaced by "carries a `SKILL.md` and is not `metadata.internal`". The predicate is a copy of `isMarkedInternal` in `packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts` L608, spelled the same way. `DISPLAY` gains `{ name: 'objectui', label: 'ObjectUI' }`. Two parser changes were needed:
- `objectui`'s frontmatter `description:` is a plain one-line scalar, not a folded `>` block, and the parser read only the folded block.
- `objectui` spells its clauses "Use for" / "Do NOT use". The split now matches `Use (when|for)` and is case-insensitive on `Do not use`. The first match wins, so the ten existing entries render byte-identically. The only change in the regenerated output is the added row and card, plus the count (10 → 11).

Regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs` and committed as generated: the index block of `skills/README.md` and `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`. The `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS` population is unchanged: `skills/*/SKILL.md` already covered `objectui/SKILL.md`. Cross-seat note: `packages/spec/scripts` belongs to `domain:spec`, and per the triage it rides along here with no spec seat online. `@objectstack/spec` does not publish `scripts/` (its `files` list), so the changeset is `@objectstack/skills` only.

### 3. Three dead anchors

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` L961: the "Project hooks pattern" line pointed at `../SKILL.md#lifecycle-hooks`. The data `SKILL.md` has no hooks section any more, and its Quick Reference row (L46) routes to this very file. The line is deleted (seat ruling). The fix is the deletion; the home is this file.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` L259 now points at `../references/plugin-development.md#complete-plugin-example`. That section (L164) is the AuditPlugin example the sentence describes: a service registered in `init()`, `kernel:ready` / `metadata:reloaded` hooks, cleanup in `destroy()`.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md` L147-149 now points at `../references/plugin-development.md#well-known-plugin-names--services`, and the hand-written "13 rows" is dropped per #27522. **Card premise corrected:** the card said that heading exists nowhere. It exists at `references/plugin-development.md` L280, with 12 rows, not 13.

### 4. `bootstrap.md` pins the current version

`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`: all five pins in the starting `package.json` (L147-153, not only the two the card named) are now `18.3.0`. That is the version in `packages/skills/package.json`, `packages/spec`, `packages/runtime`, `packages/cli`, `plugin-hono-server`, and every SKILL.md `metadata.version`. The edit is the same byte length.

### 5. Complete object examples author `sharingModel`

Code site: `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` L843-877. A non-system object with no `sharingModel` is `security-owd-unset` (error). The object counts as system when `isSystemObject` (L280) says so: `isSystem: true` or a `sys_` name.

- `rules/relationships.md`: `sharingModel: 'private'` on `account`, `contact`, `invoice`, `project`, `employee`, `project_assignment` and `category`. `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'` on the two `master_detail` children, `invoice_line_item` and `invoice_line` (the lint hint's prescription for master-detail children, consistent with the file's § Owner edits and its Relationship Types "Sharing: Inherits parent"). The ❌ counter-example (`invoice_line_item` with a `lookup`) is a complete create call, and it stays as it is: it is kept as a labelled counter-example under § Incorrect vs Correct, a shape the page tells the reader not to write.
- `rules/lifecycle.md`: `sharingModel: 'private'` on `api_call_log`, `import_ticket` and `consent_log`. `sys_automation_run` is a system object (`sys_` prefix, `isSystemObject`), so it is exempt and unchanged.
- `rules/datasources.md`: `sharingModel: 'public_read'` on `ext_customer`. The binding has no `external.writable: true`, so it is read-only (`validate-external-owner-sharing.ts` L190), and the lint's prescription for an unprovable owner anchor is `READ_ONLY_EXTERNAL_WAY_OUT` (L136): `'public_read'`, because on `'private'` a member reads no row.
- **No edit, measured:** `references/bootstrap.md` and `references/plugin-development.md` hold no complete example. Each mentions `ObjectSchema.create({ … })` only in prose, so the card's 1/0 counts are the prose mentions. `bootstrap.md` names the scaffolder's `note.object.ts` as the shape to copy, and that file authors `sharingModel: 'private'` (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/objects/note.object.ts` L54).

### 6. System columns: what was confirmed

- **`examples-objects.md`: card premise wrong, measured, no edit (seat ruling B).** An explicit `created_at` / `created_by` declaration is neither refused nor merely shadowed. `applySystemFields` lets the author's declaration win and forces only `readonly: true` / `system: true` over it (`packages/metadata-core/src/audit-field-governance.ts`, module note L10-15 and `applyAuditFieldGovernance` L121; `label`, `group` and even `type` stay the author's). And `packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts` L18-21 leaves audit fields out of a grouped layout unless the author explicitly groups them. So `created_at: { …, group: 'system' }` is the supported way to show them in that example's System section. The serial wait on #31127 is moot: the file is untouched.
- **`rules/indexing.md` § Multi-Tenant Queries: fixed.** The injected tenant column is `organization_id`, governed by `systemFields.tenant` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L3309: "the column is always provisioned; the multi-tenant flag governs only its index"). On a multi-tenant host the registry adds the single-column index itself (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` L1692, `provisionTenantScopeIndex` L1694). An index naming an undeclared `tenant_id` is refused: `indexes[].fields[]` existence is judged against the authored fields plus the injected columns (`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `INDEX_POSITION` L320). The example now indexes `['organization_id', 'status', 'created_at']`, with one paragraph on `systemFields.tenant` and the automatic index. The paragraph scopes the composite to non-unique indexes, because the neighbouring § unique scopes says "do NOT list `organization_id` yourself" for `unique: 'organization'`.

### 7. `plugin-ai` eval: card premise wrong, measured, no edit

`skills/objectui/evals/project-setup.json` L20 lists `@object-ui/plugin-ai` under `must_not_contain` (the same at `aa3e21cc`). The fixture already penalises an answer that names the retired package, so there is nothing to replace (seat ruling A).

### 8. `$empty` is taught: confirmed

`$empty` is in `FILTER_OPERATORS` (`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` L3377), declared on both operator schemas (L1829, L1905), and is the lowering target of `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` (L2760-2763). Its semantics are the ruled per-type table `EMPTY_PREDICATE_DESCRIPTION` (L1796).
- `rules/filters.md` Operator Reference: one row, `$empty` → "`IS NULL`, `''` or `[]` by type".
- `SKILL.md` § Null & Existence Operators: the row, an example (`false` = has content), and two sentences: the view operators lower to it, and a face that judges by declared type refuses it on a column it holds no declaration for (the built-in `id`), so use `$null` there.
- `$regex` / `$options` stay out.

### 9. Upgrade roster

`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`: the prose before the `skills remove` block says `objectstack-pm-dispatch` is not in the 18 catalog and that only an older install has it (#17311). The prose carries the note, not the command, so the command stays copy-pasteable. The roster also gains `objectui` (seat review S2): a 17.x project installed it from `objectstack-ai/objectui`, so it has a github-sourced `skills-lock.json` entry that the sync skips, like the `objectstack-*` ones.

`skills/README.md` is outside every skill directory and is not ratcheted. No ceiling is raised, so the ruling path was not used. No line was re-wrapped. Every deletion, with the facts it held and where each survives:

- **`objectui/README.md`:** the `skills.sh` badge (a pointer to the archived repo's listing; no surviving home needed). The "CLI auto-detects your agent… (e.g. `.claude/skills/objectui/`…) See skills.sh/docs" sentence. Facts: auto-detection is false under the taught `--agent` install; the landing directory and the other agents are in the catalog README (§ install: "the skills land as real files in `.claude/skills/`", "Name your own runtime after `--agent`"), which the new text links.
- **`data-hooks.md`:** the dead "Project hooks pattern" reference line (item 3). Its home is this file, which the data `SKILL.md` Quick Reference routes to.
- **`relationships.md`:**
  - § ✅ Correct — Junction Object Pattern: the `post_tag` block is replaced by "The [junction object](#many-to-many-junction-object) pattern above.", mirroring the master_detail Correct entry. Facts: a junction is an explicit object with two `lookup`s, both `required: true`. Home: § Many-to-Many: Junction Object (`project_assignment`, same shape, plus its unique pair index).
  - The `// Contact can exist without account` comment on `required: false`. Homes: the example's own `// Child: Contact (independent lifecycle)` and the Relationship Types row `lookup | Independent | Optional by default`.
- **`lifecycle.md`:**
  - The intro's "— and, at its end, the save notice a hook hands the saver." Home: § Save Notice, and the data `SKILL.md` Quick Reference row.
  - `// must: after === maxAge` on the ConsentLog `archive` line. It was the page's only statement of the equality that `object.zod.ts` L1067 enforces at parse, so the follow-up commit restates it at its home (seat review S1). The § Validation Rules counter-example's comment now reads `// ❌ archive.after must equal retention.maxAge`, in place of "❌ Archive window detached from the hot window".
- **`datasources.md`:** ", not only on a federated object" in the `columnName` bullet. Home: the same bullet's "on ANY object" and "everywhere".
- **`query/rules/filters.md`:**
  - "; `$null: false` is `IS NOT NULL`" in § Prefer `$null`. Home: the Operator Reference `$null` row (`IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL`) and `SKILL.md`'s Null table.
  - The `// Records created in the last 7 days (compute date in application code)` comment. Its first half did not match the code below it (a fixed `new Date('2025-01-01')`), and its second half is the section's lead sentence ("For **ad-hoc queries in application code**, compute the date yourself").

## Link walk

`/mnt/project-files/card-31114/linkwalk.py` (project folder) walks every `skills/**/*.md` outside code fences and inline code. It checks that relative links resolve to a file, that `#anchors` match a GitHub heading slug or an `<a id>` in the target, and that `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/(tree|blob)/main/<path>` links name a path that exists in the checkout.
- `main` (`98583cd6`): 243 links, 3 broken (exactly item 3's three).
- This branch: 248 links, **0 broken**.
- The repo's own `ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` (in `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, a derived gate) also covers `skills/objectui` and is green.

## Eval cases

- `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 8 (new, item 5): `project` + owned `milestone`. Must contain `ObjectSchema.create`, `sharingModel: 'private'`, `sharingModel: 'controlled_by_parent'`, `master_detail`, `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`; must not contain `many_to_many`, `deleteBehavior: 'set_null'`.
- `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 9 (new, item 6): a multi-tenant index for an organization's open tickets. Must contain `indexes`, `organization_id`; `must_not_contain` is empty, because a careful answer warns against `tenant_id` by name, as the case's own `expected_output` does (seat review N1).
- `objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 11 (new, item 5; renumbered from 10 when #31127's case 10 landed on `main`): a read-only external `ext_supplier`. Must contain `ObjectSchema.create`, `remoteName`, `sharingModel: 'public_read'`; must not contain `columnName:`.
- `objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` case 7 (new, item 8): tasks with no notes, where a blank string counts as none. Must contain `$empty: true`; `must_not_contain` is empty, because an answer that warns against the retired `$regex` / `$options` by name must not fail (seat review N1).
- Item 7: no case changed (see § 7). No existing case encoded a corrected claim: I grepped every touched skill's `evals/` for `tenant_id`, `objectstack-ai/objectui`, `18.1.0` and the three dead anchors, with no hits.

## Other sites found (not changed: outside this card's file surface)

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx` L204 and `v14.mdx` L298 link the archived `objectui` CHANGELOG. These are release notes, which Human Minimum item 7 says not to hand-edit. The other `objectstack-ai/objectui` hits under `content/docs/frontend/**` are historical issue links, which are correct as they are.
- No other skill file holds a complete `ObjectSchema.create` example without `sharingModel` (swept: every `skills/**/*.md` with a create call).

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates: 97 derived, 97 exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 97 commands for the 20 changed paths. Each one ran under `timeout 900` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, and its exit code was captured before any pipe. The full list with exit codes is in the project folder, `card-31114/gates-e6dcc651.txt`.
- A first pass on the pre-amend commit had 5 reds: 4 from the environment, 1 real. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 because this shallow clone lacks its pinned fixture commit; fixed with `git fetch origin 621a4876…`. `check:skill-examples` (exit 3), `check:dts-closure` (exit 1) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3) failed with no `dist/`, before `pnpm build` (exit 0) had finished. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (exit 1) caught a real defect: `check-doc-links` refused the relative `../README.md` in `skills/objectui/README.md`, which now uses an absolute URL (see § 1). The rest of that file's reds were build-dependent.
- After the fix and the build, all 97 were rerun on the amended commit (`e6dcc651`): **97 exit 0**. That includes `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` (283 blocks), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, the ui `scripts/` suite (4996 tests) and the token ratchet.

</details>
